items.question: Trong câu "An API (Application Programming Interface) is an interface that allows software systems to communicate with each other.", từ "interface" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An API (Application Programming Interface) is an interface that allows software systems to communicate with each other.", what does "interface" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interface /ˈɪntəfeɪs/ (danh từ): giao diện (điểm kết nối). "An interface that allows systems to communicate" = giao diện giúp các hệ thống trao đổi; "user interface" = giao diện người dùng.
items.explanationEn: interface /ˈɪntəfeɪs/ (noun): a point where systems connect. "An interface that allows systems to communicate" is a connection point; "user interface" is what people see.

items.question: Trong câu "An API (Application Programming Interface) is an interface that allows software systems to communicate with each other.", từ "allow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An API (Application Programming Interface) is an interface that allows software systems to communicate with each other.", what does "allow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (động từ): cho phép, giúp có thể. "Allows software systems to communicate" = cho phép các hệ thống giao tiếp; cấu trúc "allow X to do Y".
items.explanationEn: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (verb): to make possible. "Allows software systems to communicate" follows the pattern "allow X to do Y".

items.question: Trong câu "An API (Application Programming Interface) is an interface that allows software systems to communicate with each other.", từ "each other" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An API (Application Programming Interface) is an interface that allows software systems to communicate with each other.", what does "each other" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: each other /iːtʃ ˈʌðə(r)/ (cụm từ): lẫn nhau, với nhau. "Communicate with each other" = giao tiếp với nhau; dùng khi hai bên cùng tác động qua lại.
items.explanationEn: each other /iːtʃ ˈʌðə(r)/ (phrase): one another. "Communicate with each other" means both sides talk to one another.

items.question: Trong câu "Real-world example: When you book a Grab ride, the Grab app calls the Google Maps API to get the map and calculate the route.", từ "book" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Real-world example: When you book a Grab ride, the Grab app calls the Google Maps API to get the map and calculate the route.", what does "book" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: book /bʊk/ (động từ): đặt (chỗ, xe). "Book a ride" = đặt xe; tương tự "book a room", "book a ticket". Danh từ: booking.
items.explanationEn: book /bʊk/ (verb): to reserve a service. "Book a ride" means reserve one; similarly "book a room", "book a ticket". Noun: booking.

items.question: Trong câu "Real-world example: When you book a Grab ride, the Grab app calls the Google Maps API to get the map and calculate the route.", từ "route" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Real-world example: When you book a Grab ride, the Grab app calls the Google Maps API to get the map and calculate the route.", what does "route" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the way from A to B
items.explanation: route /ruːt/ (danh từ): tuyến đường, lộ trình. "Calculate the route" = tính lộ trình; trong web, "route" còn là đường dẫn định tuyến (routing).
items.explanationEn: route /ruːt/ (noun): the way from A to B. "Calculate the route" means work out the way; in web apps a "route" is a URL mapping.

items.question: Trong câu "Every exchange has two roles:", từ "exchange" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every exchange has two roles:", what does "exchange" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: exchange /ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (danh từ): lượt trao đổi (qua lại). "Every exchange has two roles" = mỗi lượt trao đổi có hai vai; "stock exchange" = sàn chứng khoán.
items.explanationEn: exchange /ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (noun): a back-and-forth interaction. "Every exchange" here is one request and its reply; a "stock exchange" is a market.

items.question: Trong câu "Every exchange has two roles:", từ "role" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every exchange has two roles:", what does "role" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: role /rəʊl/ (danh từ): vai trò. "Two roles" = hai vai trò (client và server); "play a role in" = đóng vai trò trong.
items.explanationEn: role /rəʊl/ (noun): a function or part. "Two roles" are the client and the server; "play a role in" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Server (the provider): the system running the API that returns data, e.g. Google Maps.", từ "provider" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Server (the provider): the system running the API that returns data, e.g. Google Maps.", what does "provider" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: provider /prəˈvaɪdə(r)/ (danh từ): bên cung cấp. "The provider" = bên cung cấp dữ liệu/dịch vụ; "cloud provider" = nhà cung cấp đám mây.
items.explanationEn: provider /prəˈvaɪdə(r)/ (noun): one that supplies something. "The provider" supplies data or a service; "cloud provider" is a common term.

items.question: Trong câu "Key rule: the client always initiates the request, and the server only responds.", từ "initiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Key rule: the client always initiates the request, and the server only responds.", what does "initiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: initiate /ɪˈnɪʃieɪt/ (động từ): khởi xướng, bắt đầu. "The client initiates the request" = client là bên khởi tạo yêu cầu; "initiate" còn nghĩa là kết nạp.
items.explanationEn: initiate /ɪˈnɪʃieɪt/ (verb): to start something. "The client initiates the request" means it starts it; "initiate" can also mean admit into a group.

items.question: Trong câu "Key rule: the client always initiates the request, and the server only responds.", từ "respond" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Key rule: the client always initiates the request, and the server only responds.", what does "respond" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: respond /rɪˈspɒnd/ (động từ): phản hồi, đáp lại. "The server only responds" = máy chủ chỉ phản hồi; "respond to a request" = đáp lại yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: respond /rɪˈspɒnd/ (verb): to reply. "The server only responds" means it only replies; the pattern is "respond to something".

items.question: Trong câu "REST (Representational State Transfer) is the most popular API architecture today, operating over HTTP.", từ "architecture" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "REST (Representational State Transfer) is the most popular API architecture today, operating over HTTP.", what does "architecture" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: architecture /ˈɑːkɪtektʃə(r)/ (danh từ): kiến trúc (hệ thống). "API architecture" = kiến trúc API, cách tổ chức hệ thống; "software architecture" rất hay gặp.
items.explanationEn: architecture /ˈɑːkɪtektʃə(r)/ (noun): the design of a system. "API architecture" is how the system is designed; "software architecture" is a common term.

items.question: Trong câu "REST (Representational State Transfer) is the most popular API architecture today, operating over HTTP.", từ "operate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "REST (Representational State Transfer) is the most popular API architecture today, operating over HTTP.", what does "operate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: operate /ˈɒpəreɪt/ (động từ): hoạt động, vận hành. "Operating over HTTP" = hoạt động trên nền HTTP; "operate on" với bác sĩ là phẫu thuật.
items.explanationEn: operate /ˈɒpəreɪt/ (verb): to work or run. "Operating over HTTP" means running on top of it; "operate on" a patient means surgery.

items.question: Trong câu "Use HTTP Methods to express actions.", từ "express" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use HTTP Methods to express actions.", what does "express" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: express /ɪkˈspres/ (động từ): thể hiện, diễn đạt. "Express actions" = thể hiện hành động (GET, POST...); tính từ "express" = tốc hành.
items.explanationEn: express /ɪkˈspres/ (verb): to show or state. "Express actions" means show which action is wanted; the adjective "express" means fast.

items.question: Trong câu "Stateless: each request is independent and does not remember previous state.", từ "independent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stateless: each request is independent and does not remember previous state.", what does "independent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: independent /ˌɪndɪˈpendənt/ (tính từ): độc lập. "Each request is independent" = mỗi yêu cầu độc lập, không phụ thuộc yêu cầu trước; "independent of" = không phụ thuộc vào.
items.explanationEn: independent /ˌɪndɪˈpendənt/ (adjective): not relying on others. "Each request is independent" means it does not rely on earlier ones; "independent of" is the pattern.

items.question: Trong câu "Stateless: each request is independent and does not remember previous state.", từ "previous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stateless: each request is independent and does not remember previous state.", what does "previous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: previous /ˈpriːviəs/ (tính từ): trước đó. "Previous state" = trạng thái trước đó; trái nghĩa: next, subsequent.
items.explanationEn: previous /ˈpriːviəs/ (adjective): coming before. "Previous state" is the state before; opposites: next, subsequent.

items.question: Trong câu "Stateless: each request is independent and does not remember previous state.", từ "state" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stateless: each request is independent and does not remember previous state.", what does "state" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (danh từ): trạng thái. "Previous state" = trạng thái trước; "stateless" = không lưu trạng thái giữa các yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (noun): a condition at a moment. "Previous state" is the earlier condition; "stateless" means no state is kept between requests.

items.question: Trong câu "Partially update the product with id=5", từ "partially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Partially update the product with id=5", what does "partially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: partially /ˈpɑːʃəli/ (trạng từ): một phần. "Partially update" = cập nhật một phần (PATCH); trái nghĩa: fully (PUT).
items.explanationEn: partially /ˈpɑːʃəli/ (adverb): in part only. "Partially update" means change only some fields (PATCH); the opposite is "fully" (PUT).

items.question: Trong câu "A complete HTTP request always has 4 parts:", từ "complete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A complete HTTP request always has 4 parts:", what does "complete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: complete /kəmˈpliːt/ (tính từ): đầy đủ, hoàn chỉnh. "A complete HTTP request" = một yêu cầu HTTP đầy đủ các phần; "a complete stranger" = người hoàn toàn xa lạ.
items.explanationEn: complete /kəmˈpliːt/ (adjective): having all parts. "A complete HTTP request" has all its parts; in "a complete stranger" it means total.

items.question: Trong câu "The address of the resource to act on", từ "act on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The address of the resource to act on", what does "act on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: act on /ækt ɒn/ (cụm từ): tác động lên, xử lý. "The resource to act on" = tài nguyên cần thao tác; "act on advice" = làm theo lời khuyên.
items.explanationEn: act on /ækt ɒn/ (phrase): to operate on. "The resource to act on" is what the request works on; "act on advice" means follow it.

items.question: Trong câu "The action to perform", từ "perform" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The action to perform", what does "perform" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (động từ): thực hiện. "The action to perform" = hành động cần thực hiện; danh từ "performance" còn là hiệu năng.
items.explanationEn: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (verb): to carry out. "The action to perform" is what to carry out; the noun "performance" also means speed.

items.question: Trong câu "Accompanying info (format, auth…)", từ "accompanying" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accompanying info (format, auth…)", what does "accompanying" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accompanying /əˈkʌmpəniɪŋ/ (tính từ): đi kèm. "Accompanying info" = thông tin đi kèm; động từ "accompany" = đi cùng, đệm nhạc.
items.explanationEn: accompanying /əˈkʌmpəniɪŋ/ (adjective): going along with. "Accompanying info" goes along with the request; the verb "accompany" can also mean play music for.

items.question: Trong câu "Accompanying info (format, auth…)", từ "format" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accompanying info (format, auth…)", what does "format" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the way data is laid out
items.explanation: format /ˈfɔːmæt/ (danh từ): định dạng. "Format" trong header cho biết dữ liệu dạng gì (JSON...); động từ "format a disk" = định dạng ổ đĩa.
items.explanationEn: format /ˈfɔːmæt/ (noun): the way data is laid out. The "format" says how data is laid out, e.g. JSON; the verb "format a disk" means wipe and prepare it.

items.question: Trong câu "The response has a similar structure, but replaces Method + URL with a Status Code (section 6).", từ "similar" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The response has a similar structure, but replaces Method + URL with a Status Code (section 6).", what does "similar" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: similar /ˈsɪmələ(r)/ (tính từ): tương tự. "A similar structure" = cấu trúc tương tự; cấu trúc "similar to" = giống với.
items.explanationEn: similar /ˈsɪmələ(r)/ (adjective): alike but not the same. "A similar structure" is alike but not identical; the pattern is "similar to".

items.question: Trong câu "The response has a similar structure, but replaces Method + URL with a Status Code (section 6).", từ "structure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The response has a similar structure, but replaces Method + URL with a Status Code (section 6).", what does "structure" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: structure /ˈstrʌktʃə(r)/ (danh từ): cấu trúc. "A similar structure" = cấu trúc tương tự; "data structure" = cấu trúc dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: structure /ˈstrʌktʃə(r)/ (noun): how parts are arranged. "A similar structure" means parts arranged alike; "data structure" is a key IT term.

items.question: Trong câu "The response has a similar structure, but replaces Method + URL with a Status Code (section 6).", từ "replace" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The response has a similar structure, but replaces Method + URL with a Status Code (section 6).", what does "replace" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: replace /rɪˈpleɪs/ (động từ): thay thế. "Replaces Method + URL with a Status Code" = thay A bằng B; cấu trúc "replace A with B".
items.explanationEn: replace /rɪˈpleɪs/ (verb): to put in place of. "Replaces Method + URL with a Status Code" follows "replace A with B".

items.question: Trong câu "JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is the most popular text format for exchanging data via APIs.", từ "notation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is the most popular text format for exchanging data via APIs.", what does "notation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: notation /nəʊˈteɪʃn/ (danh từ): ký pháp, cách ký hiệu. "Object Notation" = cách ký hiệu đối tượng; "Big O notation" = ký pháp O lớn.
items.explanationEn: notation /nəʊˈteɪʃn/ (noun): a system of symbols. "Object Notation" is a way of writing objects with symbols; compare "Big O notation".

items.question: Trong câu "JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is the most popular text format for exchanging data via APIs.", từ "exchange" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is the most popular text format for exchanging data via APIs.", what does "exchange" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exchange /ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (động từ): trao đổi. "Exchanging data via APIs" = trao đổi dữ liệu qua API; "exchange money" = đổi tiền.
items.explanationEn: exchange /ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (verb): to send and receive. "Exchanging data via APIs" means sending it back and forth; "exchange money" means change currency.

items.question: Trong câu "JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is the most popular text format for exchanging data via APIs.", từ "via" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is the most popular text format for exchanging data via APIs.", what does "via" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: via /ˈvaɪə/ (giới từ): thông qua. "Via APIs" = thông qua API; cũng dùng cho địa điểm: "fly via Singapore".
items.explanationEn: via /ˈvaɪə/ (preposition): by means of. "Via APIs" means by means of them; also for places: "fly via Singapore".

items.question: Trong câu "{} = object (key-value pairs), [] = array (a list).", từ "pair" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "{} = object (key-value pairs), [] = array (a list).", what does "pair" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pair /peə(r)/ (danh từ): cặp (hai phần đi kèm). "Key-value pairs" = các cặp khóa-giá trị; "pair programming" = lập trình theo cặp.
items.explanationEn: pair /peə(r)/ (noun): two linked items. "Key-value pairs" are items made of a key and its value; compare "pair programming".

items.question: Trong câu "to understand nested objects, arrays of objects, and how to read data by path", từ "nested" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "to understand nested objects, arrays of objects, and how to read data by path", what does "nested" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: nested /ˈnestɪd/ (tính từ): lồng nhau. "Nested objects" = đối tượng lồng bên trong đối tượng khác; gốc từ "nest" (tổ chim).
items.explanationEn: nested /ˈnestɪd/ (adjective): placed inside another. "Nested objects" sit inside other objects; from "nest", a bird's home.

items.question: Trong câu "Every response carries a 3-digit status code telling you whether the request succeeded or failed.", từ "carry" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every response carries a 3-digit status code telling you whether the request succeeded or failed.", what does "carry" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to carry a digit in sums
items.explanation: carry /ˈkæri/ (động từ): mang, chứa (thông tin). "Every response carries a status code" = mỗi phản hồi mang một mã trạng thái; "a shop carries a product" = cửa hàng có bán.
items.explanationEn: carry /ˈkæri/ (verb): to contain or convey. "Every response carries a status code" means it contains one; a shop that "carries" a product sells it.

items.question: Trong câu "Every response carries a 3-digit status code telling you whether the request succeeded or failed.", từ "digit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every response carries a 3-digit status code telling you whether the request succeeded or failed.", what does "digit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: digit /ˈdɪdʒɪt/ (danh từ): chữ số. "A 3-digit status code" = mã trạng thái có 3 chữ số; "digital" = kỹ thuật số.
items.explanationEn: digit /ˈdɪdʒɪt/ (noun): a single number sign. "A 3-digit status code" has three number signs; related: "digital".

items.question: Trong câu "Every response carries a 3-digit status code telling you whether the request succeeded or failed.", từ "whether" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every response carries a 3-digit status code telling you whether the request succeeded or failed.", what does "whether" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: whether /ˈweðə(r)/ (liên từ): liệu... hay không. "Whether the request succeeded or failed" = liệu yêu cầu thành công hay thất bại; cấu trúc "whether A or B".
items.explanationEn: whether /ˈweðə(r)/ (conjunction): if or not. "Whether the request succeeded or failed" follows "whether A or B"; don't confuse with "weather".

items.question: Trong câu "Every response carries a 3-digit status code telling you whether the request succeeded or failed.", từ "succeed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every response carries a 3-digit status code telling you whether the request succeeded or failed.", what does "succeed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: succeed /səkˈsiːd/ (động từ): thành công. "The request succeeded" = yêu cầu thành công; "succeed someone" = kế nhiệm ai đó.
items.explanationEn: succeed /səkˈsiːd/ (verb): to achieve the aim. "The request succeeded" means it worked; "succeed someone" means take their place.

items.question: Trong câu "Every response carries a 3-digit status code telling you whether the request succeeded or failed.", từ "fail" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every response carries a 3-digit status code telling you whether the request succeeded or failed.", what does "fail" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fail /feɪl/ (động từ): thất bại, bị lỗi. "Succeeded or failed" = thành công hay thất bại; "fail an exam" = trượt kỳ thi.
items.explanationEn: fail /feɪl/ (verb): to not work. "Succeeded or failed" contrasts working with not working; "fail an exam" means not pass.

items.question: Trong câu "This is what a BA most often sees when reading logs or talking with developers.", từ "log" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is what a BA most often sees when reading logs or talking with developers.", what does "log" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: log /lɒɡ/ (danh từ): nhật ký hệ thống. "Reading logs" = đọc nhật ký hệ thống; động từ "log in" = đăng nhập.
items.explanationEn: log /lɒɡ/ (noun): a record of system events. "Reading logs" means checking records of system events; the verb "log in" means sign in.

items.question: Trong câu "Two codes people often confuse:", từ "confuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two codes people often confuse:", what does "confuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (động từ): nhầm lẫn. "Two codes people often confuse" = hai mã hay bị nhầm lẫn; "confuse A with B" = nhầm A với B.
items.explanationEn: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (verb): to mix up. "Two codes people often confuse" are easily mixed up; the pattern is "confuse A with B".

items.question: Trong câu "401 Unauthorized: not logged in / missing or wrong token.", từ "unauthorized" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "401 Unauthorized: not logged in / missing or wrong token.", what does "unauthorized" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unauthorized /ʌnˈɔːθəraɪzd/ (tính từ): chưa xác thực (chưa đăng nhập). "401 Unauthorized" thực chất nghĩa là chưa xác thực danh tính; khác "403 Forbidden" là không có quyền.
items.explanationEn: unauthorized /ʌnˈɔːθəraɪzd/ (adjective): not identified as a user. "401 Unauthorized" really means not authenticated; "403 Forbidden" means no permission.

items.question: Trong câu "401 Unauthorized: not logged in / missing or wrong token.", từ "missing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "401 Unauthorized: not logged in / missing or wrong token.", what does "missing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: missing /ˈmɪsɪŋ/ (tính từ): bị thiếu. "Missing or wrong token" = thiếu hoặc sai token; "missing person" = người mất tích.
items.explanationEn: missing /ˈmɪsɪŋ/ (adjective): absent, not provided. "Missing or wrong token" means none was sent or it is wrong; "missing person" is a lost person.

items.question: Trong câu "401 Unauthorized: not logged in / missing or wrong token.", từ "token" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "401 Unauthorized: not logged in / missing or wrong token.", what does "token" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: token /ˈtəʊkən/ (danh từ): mã thông báo (xác thực). "Wrong token" = token sai; token là chuỗi chứng minh bạn đã đăng nhập. "A token of thanks" = món quà nhỏ cảm ơn.
items.explanationEn: token /ˈtəʊkən/ (noun): a string proving identity. "Wrong token" means an invalid identity string; "a token of thanks" is a small gift.

items.question: Trong câu "403 Forbidden: logged in but lacks permission to access.", từ "forbidden" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "403 Forbidden: logged in but lacks permission to access.", what does "forbidden" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: forbidden /fəˈbɪdn/ (tính từ): bị cấm (không có quyền). "403 Forbidden" = bị cấm truy cập; động từ gốc: forbid.
items.explanationEn: forbidden /fəˈbɪdn/ (adjective): not allowed. "403 Forbidden" means not allowed; base verb: forbid.

items.question: Trong câu "403 Forbidden: logged in but lacks permission to access.", từ "lack" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "403 Forbidden: logged in but lacks permission to access.", what does "lack" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lack /læk/ (động từ): thiếu, không có. "Lacks permission" = thiếu quyền; danh từ: "a lack of" = sự thiếu hụt.
items.explanationEn: lack /læk/ (verb): to be without. "Lacks permission" means does not have it; noun phrase: "a lack of".

items.question: Trong câu "403 Forbidden: logged in but lacks permission to access.", từ "access" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "403 Forbidden: logged in but lacks permission to access.", what does "access" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: access /ˈækses/ (động từ): truy cập. "Permission to access" = quyền truy cập; danh từ: "access control" = kiểm soát truy cập.
items.explanationEn: access /ˈækses/ (verb): to get into. "Permission to access" means the right to get in; noun: "access control".

items.explanationEn: record /ˈrekɔːd/ (noun): one row of data. "Millions of records" means millions of data rows; the verb /rɪˈkɔːd/ means to write down.

items.explanationEn: specify /ˈspesɪfaɪ/ (verb): to state in detail. "Specifying a list screen" means describing it in detail; noun: specification (spec).

items.explanationEn: call back /kɔːl bæk/ (phrase): to contact the caller later. "The server calls back to that URL" means it contacts the client later; noun: callback.

items.explanationEn: efficient /ɪˈfɪʃnt/ (adjective): doing well with little waste. "Real-time and efficient" means fast and not wasteful; noun: efficiency. Compare "effective".

items.explanationEn: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪəmənt/ (noun): a thing a system must do. "Writing requirements" means stating what the system must do; "meet the requirements" is common.

items.explanation: display /dɪˈspleɪ/ (động từ): hiển thị. "Shopee displays a map" = Shopee hiển thị bản đồ; "on display" = đang trưng bày.
items.explanationEn: display /dɪˈspleɪ/ (verb): to show on screen. "Shopee displays a map" means shows it on screen; "on display" means exhibited.

items.question: Trong câu "Shopee displays a map of the delivery address", từ "delivery" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Shopee displays a map of the delivery address", what does "delivery" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: delivery /dɪˈlɪvəri/ (danh từ): giao hàng. "The delivery address" = địa chỉ giao hàng; động từ: deliver.
items.explanationEn: delivery /dɪˈlɪvəri/ (noun): bringing goods to a buyer. "The delivery address" is where goods are sent; verb: deliver.

items.question: Trong câu "The Grab app calculates the fare", từ "calculate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Grab app calculates the fare", what does "calculate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: calculate /ˈkælkjuleɪt/ (động từ): tính toán. "Calculates the fare" = tính cước phí; danh từ: calculation.
items.explanationEn: calculate /ˈkælkjuleɪt/ (verb): to work out with numbers. "Calculates the fare" means works out the price; noun: calculation.

items.question: Trong câu "The Grab app calculates the fare", từ "fare" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Grab app calculates the fare", what does "fare" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fare /feə(r)/ (danh từ): giá cước (đi xe). "Calculates the fare" = tính cước xe; "taxi fare", "bus fare". Đừng nhầm với "fair".
items.explanationEn: fare /feə(r)/ (noun): the price of a ride. "The fare" is what a ride costs; "taxi fare", "bus fare". Not to be confused with "fair".

items.question: Trong câu "Internal pricing API", từ "internal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Internal pricing API", what does "internal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: internal /ɪnˈtɜːnl/ (tính từ): nội bộ. "Internal pricing API" = API tính giá nội bộ; trái nghĩa: external.
items.explanationEn: internal /ɪnˈtɜːnl/ (adjective): used inside an organisation. "Internal pricing API" is used only inside the company; the opposite is external.

items.question: Trong câu "Internal pricing API", từ "pricing" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Internal pricing API", what does "pricing" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pricing /ˈpraɪsɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc định giá. "Pricing API" = API định giá; "pricing strategy" = chiến lược giá.
items.explanationEn: pricing /ˈpraɪsɪŋ/ (noun): setting prices. "Pricing API" sets prices; "pricing strategy" is a business term.

items.question: Trong câu "A website allows login with Google", từ "allow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A website allows login with Google", what does "allow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (động từ): cho phép. "Allows login with Google" = cho phép đăng nhập bằng Google; "allow for" = tính đến.
items.explanationEn: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (verb): to permit. "Allows login with Google" means lets users do it; "allow for" means take into account.

items.question: Trong câu "VNPAY reports the payment result back to the shop", từ "report" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "VNPAY reports the payment result back to the shop", what does "report" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: report /rɪˈpɔːt/ (động từ): báo lại, thông báo. "Reports the payment result back" = báo lại kết quả thanh toán; "report to" = báo cáo cho cấp trên.
items.explanationEn: report /rɪˈpɔːt/ (verb): to tell the result. "Reports the payment result back" means tells the shop the outcome; "report to" a manager is also common.

items.question: Trong câu "VNPAY reports the payment result back to the shop", từ "payment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "VNPAY reports the payment result back to the shop", what does "payment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: payment /ˈpeɪmənt/ (danh từ): thanh toán. "The payment result" = kết quả thanh toán; "payment gateway" = cổng thanh toán.
items.explanationEn: payment /ˈpeɪmənt/ (noun): paying for something. "The payment result" says if paying worked; "payment gateway" is a common term.

items.question: Trong câu "Webhooks let the server push real-time updates instead of the client having to poll.", từ "push" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Webhooks let the server push real-time updates instead of the client having to poll.", what does "push" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: push /pʊʃ/ (động từ): đẩy (dữ liệu xuống). "Push real-time updates" = chủ động đẩy cập nhật; "push notification" = thông báo đẩy.
items.explanationEn: push /pʊʃ/ (verb): to send data out to. "Push real-time updates" means the server sends them unasked; compare "push notification".

items.question: Trong câu "Webhooks let the server push real-time updates instead of the client having to poll.", từ "instead of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Webhooks let the server push real-time updates instead of the client having to poll.", what does "instead of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "Instead of the client having to poll" = thay vì client phải hỏi liên tục; sau "instead of" dùng V-ing.
items.explanationEn: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (phrase): in place of. "Instead of the client having to poll" uses the -ing form after "instead of".

items.question: Trong câu "Webhooks let the server push real-time updates instead of the client having to poll.", từ "poll" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Webhooks let the server push real-time updates instead of the client having to poll.", what does "poll" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: poll /pəʊl/ (động từ): hỏi dò định kỳ. "Having to poll" = phải hỏi dò liên tục; danh từ "a poll" = cuộc thăm dò ý kiến.
items.explanationEn: poll /pəʊl/ (verb): to check again and again. "Having to poll" means checking repeatedly; the noun "a poll" is an opinion survey.

items.question: Trong câu "JSON = the most popular data format (see the dedicated JSON article).", từ "dedicated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JSON = the most popular data format (see the dedicated JSON article).", what does "dedicated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dedicated /ˈdedɪkeɪtɪd/ (tính từ): dành riêng. "The dedicated JSON article" = bài viết dành riêng cho JSON; "a dedicated worker" = người tận tụy.
items.explanationEn: dedicated /ˈdedɪkeɪtɪd/ (adjective): made for one purpose. "The dedicated JSON article" is written only for JSON; "a dedicated worker" is devoted.
